verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a passing mention that 'ChatGPT data controls' apply to content processed through ChatGPT, including Computer Use screenshots. This shows the product has its own data-control settings, but never says they govern model training. The memories toggles are an adjacent control and do not count toward this story. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a model-training opt-out toggle, description of where and how to set it, coverage across chat/Work/Codex surfaces, independent or hands-on corroboration.
